notes.title: New Update Available: Russia & Japan Expansion
notes.content:
Detectives, pack your bags—CrimeBot 2 is going global! In this brand-new update, the investigation deepens as two iconic locations join the case files: Russia and Japan. Explore snowy backstreets, neon-lit alleys, and cultural mysteries that blur the line between East and West.

Your trusted assistant Sophie continues to accompany you, bringing sharp insights and witty remarks as you uncover secrets hidden in two very different corners of the world.

What’s New:

🌍 New Locations: Investigate chilling cases in Russia and high-tech mysteries in Japan.

🧩 New Clues & Cases: Fresh dossiers and puzzles tailored to each setting.

🗣️ Sophie Returns: With new lines, reactions, and observations tailored to each location.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements: To ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

Thank you for joining us on this journey. The case files are open—will you solve them all?

notes.title: The Art of Interrogation - Expansion
notes.content:
We're excited to bring you our first expansion update: Patch 1.4.0 "The Art of Interrogation." In this update, suspect characters now come to life and can be interrogated. Your interrogation skills will let you unmask the culprit or clear the innocent, while Assistant Sophie springs to life, interacting directly at crime scenes. Additionally, the narrative has been extended with a richer, deeper plot.

What's new:

- Dynamic Suspects & Interrogations: Suspect characters now come to life. Engage in interrogations where your skill can reveal the culprit or clear the innocent. Remember, each interrogation consumes an investigation, so use them wisely!
- Enhanced Clue System: New clues enrich your investigations, making each case even more engaging.
- Interactive Assistant Sophie: Now active at crime scenes, Sophie brings valuable insights to your investigations.
- Expanded Narrative: Enjoy a story with deeper plot layers and more immersive gameplay.
- Bug Fixes: Various fixes to improve game stability and fluidity.

We sincerely thank all our players for the invaluable feedback and support. We will do our best to continue improving the game.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update v1.1.1
notes.content:
Greetings, Detectives! Here's what's new in this update:

📝 Improved Korean Translation
The translation in korean has been fixed based on some feedback of korean players.

🌏 Added Support for Traditional Chinese
The game is now available in Traditional Chinese for a wider audience.

🔧 Offline Mode Bug Fixed
Resolved an issue preventing the game from functioning properly in offline mode.

🐞 Minor Bugs Fixed
Addressed several player-reported issues to improve stability and gameplay.

Thank you for your feedback and support! Happy investigation! 🕵️‍♂️🔍
– The CrimeBot 2 Team

notes.title: Unleash Your Style with Enhanced Detective Customization!
notes.content:
Dear Detectives,

We are excited to share the latest updates and improvements in this new patch! Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've worked hard to enhance your investigative experience. Here's what’s new in CrimeBot 2: Unsolved Cold Case:

🕵️‍♂️ Profile Customization
- Expanded to 96 unique player profiles with greater ethnic variety.

🔍 Suspect Generation
- Added images for suspects of Arab, African, and Asian ethnicities.
- Improved ethnicity-based image assignment and suspect name generation.

⚙️ Gameplay Updates
- Enhanced crime scene object visuals to match evidence.

🏆 Ranked Mode Fixes
- Resolved score tracking and progression bar bugs.
- Fixed badge display in player profiles.

🛠️ Bug Fixes
- Fixed badge purchase bug with XP.
- Resolved suspect card movement issue.
- Corrected visuals, labels, and spelling errors across the game.

Update your game now and share your feedback!
